landing.badge: Open source · AGPL-3.0 · Runs entirely on free tiers
landing.subhead: The real-time insider-trading tape. When executives trade their own stock, it shows up here — normalized across markets, classified for signal, and free to query.
landing.kicker: SEC EDGAR · NSE / BSE · US Congress
landing.tapeEmpty: No filings on the tape yet. New Form 4s appear here within about a minute of reaching EDGAR.

stats.hint: Recomputed from the live database on every rebuild.

realtime.title: Real-time EDGAR tape
realtime.body: A 1-minute cron watches SEC filings; a Form 4 lands in the database — and on this page — within about a minute of hitting EDGAR.

multiMarket.title: Multi-market, one schema
multiMarket.body: US and India today, adapter-ready for more. Every market normalizes into one taxonomy with native currency and USD side by side.

signal.title: Signal over noise
signal.body: Every trade is classified routine (grants, 10b5-1 plans, tax withholding) or opportunistic — the discretionary trades worth watching.

api.title: Free public API
api.body: Typed JSON, RSS feeds, and a live SSE stream. Rate-limited, cached, documented with OpenAPI. No key required to start.

footer.sourcesBody: US data comes from SEC EDGAR, a US-government service whose filings are in the public domain; access follows the SEC fair-access policy. NSE/BSE (India) data is subject to restrictive exchange terms and is not redistributed by this project.
footer.disclaimerBody: InsiderFlow republishes public regulatory filings for research and education. Filings can be late, amended, incomplete, or wrong, and insider activity is not a reliable predictor of returns. Analytics on this site are backward-looking descriptive statistics, not forecasts.

landing.accessLead: All insider data is free to read.
landing.accessBody: No account, no paywall, no row limits. Sign in only to save watchlists, set alerts, and get an API key.

access.bannerText: Live data is free and public.
access.bannerCta: Sign in to save & get alerts
access.watchlistEmptyBody: Every trade on this site is already yours to read. A watchlist just keeps the companies and insiders you care about in one place, and tells you when they file.
access.alertsEmptyBody: Screens are free to run and free to share as a link. An alert re-runs one for you and sends it to Telegram or email the moment it matches.
access.signInPopoverTitle: Sign in to save this alert
access.signInPopoverBody: Reading stays free either way — this only saves it to your account.
access.emailSent: Check your email for the sign-in link.
access.emailFailed: Could not send the link. Try again.
access.rowAlertSaved: Alerting on {ticker} — tune delivery in Settings
access.rowAlertFailed: Could not save that alert — try again

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: The tape takes one tab stop, then the arrow keys walk it.
shortcuts.rowWatchKey: Track or stop tracking the focused company
